rationale: The complete captured Adebayo et al. source directly supports a bounded claim: selected saliency methods can be insensitive to model parameters or label structure, so visual plausibility alone cannot establish faithful explanation. The claim preserves the paper's method-specific visual-classification scope and does not generalize the finding to every interpretability technique.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-006-R1, PDF p. 1 abstract: visual assessment alone can mislead
S-EVID-006-R2, PDF p. 2 contribution list: some tested methods independent of model parameters and labels
limitations: The result does not establish that all saliency or interpretability methods fail.
It supplies no transport safety threshold or evidence for a particular learned controller.
